name: 腾讯游戏防沉迷家长管控助手
examples_zh: 孩子玩游戏时间太长，我该怎么设置限制？
怎么查孩子最近在玩哪些游戏？
孩子用我的账号玩游戏，有什么办法管住？
examples_en: My child plays games for too long. How can I set limits?
How can I check which games my child has played recently?
My child uses my account to play games. How can I manage it?
description_zh: 帮助家长判断孩子游戏场景下该如何合理管理，推荐合适的管控功能、操作路径和注意事项。
description_en: Helps parents manage children's gaming with feature recommendations, operation paths, and practical guidance for Tencent game parental controls.
